description: Icons buttons are simple, icon-only buttons that can be used for actions and in toolbars.For a full list of icons that come bundled with Synergy, refer to the Assets.Note: To make the icon-button work in development, have a look at the icon documentation for how to set up the assets package.
title: Default

description: Use the size attribute to change a icon-button size.
title: Sizes

description: The Icon button can have two color variants, Primary or Neutral Color.
title: Colors

This gives you all the default link behavior the browser provides (e.g. CMD/CTRL/SHIFT + CLICK) and exposes the target and download attributes.
title: Link Button

description: Use the disabled attribute to disable the icon button.
title: Disabled

description: The focus event gives the user feedback that the icon-button has been focused by the keyboard interaction.

description: A description that gets read by assistive devices. For optimal accessibility, you have to include a label that describes what the icon button does.
